name: Honeycombe-on-the-Wold
tagline: A honey-stone village in a green fold of the Wolds.
opening: Help Honeycombe look its best before the village judges arrive.

intro.title: A new assignment
intro.body:
Dear Photographer,

Welcome to the Wold & Vale Postcard Company! Your first assignment is Honeycombe-on-the-Wold, which has entered the county's Best-Kept Village competition.

The village is lovely, but it has let itself go a little. Tidy each spot until it is picture-perfect, then take the postcard. They sell like hot cakes at the Post Office, and every penny goes into the Village Fund to put the place to rights.

The train gets in at eleven. Colonel Whitby will meet you.

Yours, with great expectations,
Clementine Ashby
Editor

welcome.title: Welcome to Honeycombe!
welcome.body:
Ah, the photographer! Capital. Colonel Whitby, chair of the Best-Kept Village Committee.

The judges arrive in the spring and, between ourselves, the place is a shambles. Litter on the platform, signs all anyhow.

Start here at the Halt, would you? Tidy up, take your snap. Then we'll talk about the High Street.

teaser.title: A postcard from Cornwall
teaser.body:
Letter for you, sorry it's late. Postmark says Porthkennack Cove. Picture of a harbour on the front. Lovely, isn't it?

Someone there's heard about your postcards, I reckon.

finale.title: Your next assignment
finale.body:
Dear Photographer,

Best-Kept Village! The whole company is thrilled, and the Honeycombe postcards are our best-sellers of the year.

Which brings me to Porthkennack Cove in Cornwall. A fishing village on a harbour, with storms, sea mist and gulls with opinions. They've entered the Coastal Village Prize and they're asking for you by name.

The sleeper leaves Paddington on Friday. Say the word and I'll book your ticket.

Yours, very proudly,
Clementine Ashby
